in_hebrew.name: Auberta
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Light, Dawn, Bright
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Auberta הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Latin word ‘aubere’ meaning ‘to brighten up’. Auberta can be interpreted as the one who brings light or the dawn. This name is often given to girls born at sunrise or those who are believed to bring light and hope into people’s lives.
